post.description:
Exchange demo-persona credentials for a short-lived session token.

Only meaningful when the app is running with the ``demo`` identity
provider; returns 404 otherwise so a non-demo deployment doesn't expose
a login form that can never actually authenticate anything.
post.summary: Exchange demo-persona credentials for a session token

child dataset in this export must come from that upload.  It is safer to
omit a missing child than to silently add its latest version from another
workbook package.

Return auditable lineage for every overview metric.

Source metrics point to the exact workbook row and parsed field. Derived
metrics include their formula and the source inputs used by that formula.

get.description:
Return a small, read-only view centered on an immutable source cell.

``source_row_id`` identifies either an OSIP ``SourceRow`` (persisted
immutable evidence) or, for multi-source domains such as Risk, a
``DatasetRecord`` - those never persist a row-level table, so this path
re-opens the original workbook from blob storage instead.
get.summary: Read an exact source row centered on a workbook cell
